北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力较大，体感偏凉，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and feels cool. Remember to stay warm!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨体感凉，出门记得带伞，别着凉啦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and feels cool. Take an umbrella and don't catch a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，风力不大，早晚温差注意添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool. Mind the temperature difference between morning and night.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州湿度大体感闷热，多补充水分，注意防晒哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels muggy with high humidity. Stay hydrated and mind the sun.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳湿度高体感热，多喝水，小心别中暑啦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels hot and humid. Drink plenty of water to avoid heatstroke!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天有风，体感有些凉，记得加件外套哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and breezy, feels cool. Remember to wear a jacket.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京风力较大，体感偏凉，注意及时增添衣物。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is windy and feels cool. Remember to add clothes in time.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感微凉，出门别忘带件薄外套。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels slightly cool. Don't forget a light jacket.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天微凉，体感舒适，记得添减衣物喔。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and slightly cool, feels pleasant. Remember to adjust your clothing.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，气温宜人，早晚温差记得添衣。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy with pleasant temperatures. Mind the morning and evening temperature difference.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天体感凉，湿度较高，出门记得带伞哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels cool with high humidity. Don't forget an umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨风力大体感冷，注意防风保暖，别着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is windy and feels cold. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳风力较大，体感偏凉，外出注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is windy and feels cool. Take precautions against wind and cold outdoors.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感凉，湿度大，记得多穿件衣服哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels cool with high humidity. Remember to wear more clothes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雾风力大，体感凉，出行请注意交通安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and windy, feels cool. Please mind traffic safety when traveling.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感偏凉，有风，出门记得加件衣。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cool with wind. Remember to add a layer of clothing.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风力较大，体感偏冷，注意防风保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is windy and feels cold. Remember to stay warm and protected from the wind.
